title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.


You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.


  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React) — AI StartupSenior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)


About Us

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor


How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

description:

Location: Remote

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Coordenador de Expansão
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador de Expansão para fazer parte do nosso time na VAROS Consultoria.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educação. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Coordenador de Expansão do braço de Consultoria você será responsável por captar novos consultores de investimento para fazer parte do time da VAROS. Você ficará incumbido por todo o processo de recrutamento e seleção destes profissionais, mantendo uma rotina diária de prospecção de novos contatos e relacionamento com contatos atuais.


Atividades

  • Recrutamento e Prospecção de Consultores: Identificar, atrair e recrutar profissionais qualificados do mercado financeiro para atuarem como consultores de investimento na VAROS. Mapear talentos em corretoras, assets, bancos e escritórios de assessoria, utilizando sua rede de contatos e estratégias ativas de hunting;
  • Gestão do Pipeline de Candidatos: Estruturar e operar um funil de recrutamento completo: prospecção, abordagem, entrevistas, negociação e onboarding. Acompanhar métricas como volume de abordagens, taxa de conversão por etapa, tempo médio de contratação e custo por contratação;
  • Expansão Estratégica: Desenvolver e executar o plano de expansão do time de consultores, alinhado às metas de crescimento da VAROS. Identificar praças e regiões com maior potencial, priorizar mercados e definir metas de contratação por período;
  • Relacionamento com o Mercado: Manter e ampliar uma rede ativa de relacionamentos com profissionais do mercado financeiro, participando de eventos, comunidades e fóruns do setor. Ser a principal ponte entre a VAROS e talentos do mercado;
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar o processo de integração dos novos consultores, garantindo alinhamento com a cultura e os padrões da VAROS. Coordenar um time de apoio à expansão conforme a operação escalar;


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada no mercado financeiro. Você precisa já estar inserido no ecossistema de assessoria de investimentos, corretoras e gestoras por dentro;
  • Rede de contatos sólida e ativa com profissionais do mercado financeiro. Se você não conhece gente, essa vaga não é para você;
  • Histórico de atuação com recrutamento, hunting ou desenvolvimento de equipes comerciais no segmento financeiro;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia total. Você vai receber uma meta de expansão e precisará estruturar o plano e executar sem microgerenciamento;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão. Você vai convencer profissionais bem posicionados no mercado a mudarem de casa — isso exige argumentação forte e leitura de perfil;
  • Perfil relacional e executor. Você decolará nessa vaga se souber abrir portas com facilidade e, ao mesmo tempo, conseguir tocar o processo do começo ao fim sozinho. O time dará escala assim que a operação for validada;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em escritórios de assessoria de investimentos (XP, BTG, ou similares);
  • Vivência com estruturação de operações de expansão ou abertura de novos escritórios/filiais;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas ou coordenação de times comerciais no mercado financeiro;


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração competitiva e bônus por performance;

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication.   • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
