title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Murex Back Office Developer (EST working hours)
description:
Summary

DXC-Luxoft has one of the world's leading Solutions practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


We're looking for Senior Murex Back Office / Operations Developer with hands-on experience with MxML, DataMart, Batch processing and EOD flows.


Working hours: EST zone with some flexibility.


Responsibilities

  • Level 3 support to Back-Office end-user issues on both functional, technical
  • Liaise with respective internal team(s) to resolve issues and necessary enhancements
  • Develop requirements per given stream and according with resolution needs as they come along
  • Manage day-to-day assigned tasks to complete various application support deliverables
  • Contribute to support group(s) efforts in resolving request or issues
  • Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables
  • Continuous follow-up of new Application developments, enhancements, version upgrade release, regulations/practices globally, and other such items
  • Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)


Requirements

  • 3+ years' hands-on experience with Murex Back-Office functionalities (Senior level skills in pre-trade (MSL) and post-trade Murex workflows such as Contract, Events, Deliverables and/or Exchange)
  • Hands-on experience in MxML, Datamart, Batch processing, End of Day flow(s), interfaces and Trade Life Cycle
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands
  • Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills
  • Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter
  • Possess good verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have strong organization skills
  • Good product knowledge in IRD, CRD, EQD
  • Good understanding on P&L concept overall and its components
  • Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally
  • Strong experience in supporting end-users and resolving their daily issues


Nice-to-have

  • Interfaces (Market Data, C2.0)
  • Test management

  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Catálogo , com foco em qualidade, enriquecimento e padronização de dados de produtos, utilizando técnicas de Inteligência artificial.

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções baseadas em IA e Machine Learning para enriquecimento automático de produtos, como:
  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos
  • Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade)


  • Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas que conectem qualidade de catálogo com impacto em negócio e experiência do usuário (ex: conversão, busca, recomendação).
  • Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.
  • Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas e decisões analíticas.


Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado:

  • Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role:


Working closely with established Account Managers, the Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for identifying opportunities to grow JoVE’s K12 subscribers. The BDR plays a key role in the sales process, engaging potential subscribers at every stage—from initial prospecting through to closing.


Responsibilities:


  • Review target territories with Account Managers and conduct active outreach to qualify leads
  • Conduct cold calls, emails, and meetings to understand the user needs, priorities and timelines
  • Schedule meetings or product demos for the sales team with qualified leads
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop custom marketing materials
  • Manage inbound leads as needed


Requirements:


  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 2+ years of experience in sales, preferably within SaaS or Edtech markets
  • Competitive, self-motivated, and resilient
  • Excellent presentation skills, particularly in virtual settings (e.g., Zoom or other video platforms)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Results driven with an ability to work independently


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Senior Software Engineer (Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica)
description:
Senior Software Engineer


About the Role

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.


What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead and contribute to the ongoing migration of our customer support system from Zendesk to Gladly, with a go-live planned.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and integration layers within our Ruby on Rails monolith
  • Build and support internal integration services that connect our support platforms with core business systems
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative planning sessions
  • Own the quality of your work — writing tests, performing developer-driven QA, and ensuring production readiness without a dedicated QA engineer
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Support Representative (CSR) teams and ticketing platform stakeholders


Tech Stack:

  • Primary: Ruby, Ruby on Rails
  • Architecture: Rails monolith + separate integration services
  • Supporting: REST APIs, JSON, internal tooling


What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Ruby development skills are a must
  • Solid experience building and maintaining backend services and API integrations
  • Comfort working without a dedicated QA team you own testing and production readiness
  • Experience working in Agile environments (sprints, code reviews, ceremonies)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Gladly and/or Zendesk
  • Background in platform migrations
  • Full-stack exposure (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) beneficial for potential future team movement
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or Kafka

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

description:

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.

  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

  • A Master of Organization: You use project management principles, like Agile methodologies and tools to optimize processes.
  • Analytically Minded: You are comfortable with SQL, Google Sheets, AppScript, Looker Studio and possess a natural curiosity to dig into the \"why\" behind the numbers.
  • An Exceptional Communicator: You know how to be concise, persuasive, and professional. Present your ideas and insights using storytelling and with ease.

3–5 years in Project Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones. Strong proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.


PMP certification is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Healthcare Admin, Health Tech or a related field.


Tech Stack

Proficiency in PM software (Slack, Notion), CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Odoo), and BI tools (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker Studio). Agile tools / methodologies.


Industry

Experience in HealthTech or SaaS is highly preferred. Familiarity with healthcare terminology or AI/data projects is a plus.


Why Medcase?

Medcase is a supplier of global clinician expertise to the world’s leading healthcare AI organizations. We operate to streamline the human in the loop service for data curation and AI training. You will be working alongside the giants of the medical AI space. Learn from and contribute to an innovative fast developing field. Our remote first roles offer a lot of flexibility, and opportunities for growth within the startup framework.


Ready to apply? We value clarity, precision, and a bias for action. If this sounds like you, let's talk.

description:

May also supervise the Southern/Southeastern, Northern, Northeastern, and Central-West regions.

Align with the corporate strategy Offering Anchors vs. Business Fields

Reporting them promptly.

Completed technical education or ongoing higher education in Electrical, Automation, Electrotechnics, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related areas.

SICK Integration - Industrial Automation

title: Consultor De Contas Com Experiência Em Ótica
description:
Somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol.

Formada em 2018 pela combinação da Essilor e da Luxottica, nossa empresa combina dois séculos de inovação e esforço humano para elevar o cuidado com a visão e a experiência do consumidor ao seu redor.

Somos o lar das marcas de óculos e cuidados com a visão mais amadas e amplamente reconhecidas do mundo. Nossas marcas proprietárias de óculos incluem Ray-Ban, Oakley, Costa, Vogue Eyewear, Persol e Oliver Peoples, complementadas por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. Oferecemos experiências superiores de compras e pacientes com uma rede de 18.000 lojas, incluindo marcas de varejo de classe mundial como Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò e GrandVision.

  • Realizar a gestão da carteira de clientes através do contato e visitas periódicas, comunicação sobre produtos, questões financeiras ou operacionais e convites aos eventos de vendas a fim de estreitar o relacionamento;

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Economia ou correlatas;

  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades analíticas;

A EssilorLuxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCD's.

Faça parte da nossa empresa e ajude a projetar o futuro da saúde visual. Enxergue o seu #FutureInSight com a EssilorLuxottica. Nós olhamos para o futuro!

title: Executivo De Contas Ii
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Principais atividades:

- Prospectar clientes e oportunidades de negócio, apresentando os produtos e soluções da empresa de forma estratégica e consultiva;

- Receber briefings e demandas comerciais, transformando-os em propostas personalizadas de alto valor agregado;

- Elaborar, apresentar e conduzir propostas e processos comerciais com autonomia, envolvendo as áreas necessárias para garantir a viabilidade e competitividade das ofertas;

- Buscar o equilíbrio financeiro das contas sob sua gestão, propondo e conduzindo negociações de reajustes contratuais e revisões de escopo sempre que necessário;

- Apoiar a liderança na definição e execução de estratégias comerciais, contribuindo com análises, insights de mercado e comportamento da carteira de clientes;

- Organizar, atualizar e apresentar painéis de evolução dos clientes e contas sob sua gestão, com foco em performance, oportunidades e indicadores-chave;

- Monitorar o desempenho da carteira de clientes, atuando de forma proativa para maximizar resultados, satisfação e fidelização;

- Diagnosticar e atuar sobre fraquezas e riscos nas contas sob sua responsabilidade, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas junto aos times envolvidos.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

- Ter atuado na área comercial, especialmente com relacionamento ou gestão de contas;

- Experiência no mercado de saúde (como operadoras, hospitais, clínicas, corretoras ou empresas de saúde suplementar);

- Ter lidado com processos comerciais consultivos, envolvendo mais de um decisor e ciclos de venda mais longos;

- Conhecimento sobre o mercado de saúde e seus modelos de atuação;

- Ter familiaridade com tabelas de mercado (AMB, CBHPM, TUSS) será um diferencial;

- Ensino superiorcompleto (Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Gestão Comercial, Saúde ou áreas relacionadas);

- Conhecimento deExcel em nível intermediário (controle de dados, relatórios, gráficos).

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

- Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

- Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

- Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

- Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido.

Local: Campinas - SP (Irá atuar nas regiões próximo a Campinas).

Horário de Trabalho: 08h as 18h segunda a sexta-feira.

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

Saúde e Bem-estar:

- Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

- Ambulatório comclínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

- Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

- Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

Proteção e estabilidade:

- Previdência privada;

- Participação nos lucros;

- Seguro de vida.

Facilidades para o dia a dia:

- Vale-Alimentação;

- Vale-Refeição;

- Vale-Transporte;

- Auxílio-Creche;

- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.

Desenvolvimento e educação:

- Plataforma de ensino;

- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: Executivo Comercial - Hunter Para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Campinas
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;

Requisitos:

  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em Campinas, SP.
  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Desenvolvedor De Negócios
description:
Formerly Bosch Video Systems, IQSIGHT has more than 60 years of engineering expertise. Delivering intelligence-first video security that helps organizations see clearly, understand context in real time, and act with confidence, IQSIGHT transforms video into actionable insight so leaders can make better decisions, earlier. IQSIGHT offers a proven portfolio of NDAA- and TAA-compliant video solutions, including FLEXIDOME, AUTODOME, and MIC cameras, supported by more than 600 patents and designed to perform reliably over the long term.

Missão da Posição

Impulsionar de forma sustentável o crescimento do negócio, aumentando as vendas no vertical ou país sob sua responsabilidade por meio da geração de demanda e da identificação de oportunidades de projetos. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento de novos negócios, o engajamento antecipado com grandes clientes finais e grupos de influência, bem como uma atuação estratégica junto a grandes integradores de sistemas e às suas necessidades, com o objetivo de atingir as metas orçamentárias estabelecidas. Adicionalmente, apoiar o desenvolvimento da estratégia de canais e garantir sua correta implementação.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o foco de desenvolvimento de negocio para os verticais chave, assegurando acompanhamento contínuo e geração de demanda.
  • Gerar, acompanhar e ganhar oportunidades de projetos, participando ativamente no trabalho de especificações e posicionar as soluções da empresa como primeira opção de compra por parte dos clientes.
  • Gerir a relação técnica e comercial com usuários finais e influenciadores chave, apresentando e trabalhando em soluções com todas as partes relevantes.
  • Identificar e trabalhar estrategicamente com decisores e influenciadores locais, desenvolvendo e implementando planos de influência que assegurem a preferencia pelas soluções da empresa nos verticais foco.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de objetivos de vendas, aumentando a participação da empresa com os cleintes atuais e desenvolvendo novos clientes potenciais.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e dar seguimento a estratégia comercial para a carteira de clientes definida.
  • Realizar visitas regulares a clientes e trabalhar o portfólio de acordo com o perfil do cliente.

description:

Employment Type: CLT (Full-time)

Join a global leader in advanced materials and cutting tools

Work in an international environment supporting South American customers

Be part of a stable and growing industrial group with long-term career opportunities

About Us

GOLDEN EGRET BRASIL IMP. E EXP. DE CARBIDE LTDA (GESAC do Brasil) is the Brazilian subsidiary of Xiamen Golden Egret Special Alloy Co., Ltd. (GESAC), a globally recognized manufacturer of cemented carbide materials and cutting tools. GESAC is a state-controlled enterprise with a flawless track record—we have remained profitable every year since our founding in 1989. In 2024, we achieved a revenue of approximately €633.8 million (+10.56% YoY) and a net profit of €59.5 million. Our 2025 performance has continued this momentum, reaching a new record high.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Vinhedo (São Paulo), GESAC Brazil provides local inventory, fast delivery, and professional after-sales support to customers across South America.

GESAC is part of Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd. (XTC), a publicly listed industrial group with over 17,000 employees worldwide and €4.51 billion in revenue in 2024. The group has maintained strong and stable growth in advanced materials and precision tooling industries.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Specialist to support the financial operations of our Brazilian subsidiary.

This role will focus on accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash management, and financial coordination, ensuring accurate financial processes and supporting the company's operational and compliance requirements.

You will work closely with management, external accounting providers, and international teams, gaining exposure to global business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage Accounts Receivable (AR) processes, including invoice tracking, payment follow-ups, and reconciliation.
  • Handle Accounts Payable (AP), expense verification, and payment scheduling.
  • Monitor cash flow and company bank accounts, ensuring accurate transaction records.
  • Perform bank reconciliations and financial data verification.
  • Maintain and organize financial documentation and accounting archives.
  • Support payroll coordination and salary-related financial processes.
  • Assist with expense management and internal financial controls.
  • Provide English–Portuguese translation support for financial communication when required.
  • Support other financial activities compatible with the position and applicable regulations.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or Business Administration (preferred)

Experience in finance operations, accounting, AR/AP, or financial administration (preferred)

Portuguese: Native

English: Intermediate or Advanced

Solid financial and accounting knowledge

Strong analytical and organizational skills

Good knowledge of Excel and financial systems / ERP

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation

  • Gympass;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Vaga afirmativa para PCD e 40+

Especialista em Processos Industriais

A GMReis está sediada em Campinas/SP em uma área de 6.000 m², dentro de um moderno parque tecnológico, com equipamentos de produção e análise metrológica de última geração, e uma área limpa ISO classe 8 de 800 m² onde são fabricados enxertos ósseos e implantes biorreabsorvíveis.

Modelo: 100% Presencial ( Imprescindível residir em Campinas ou nas cidades próximas)

Horário: Segunda a Quinta 07:30h as 17:30 e sexta 07:30h as 16:30h.

Buscamos um Especialista em Processos Industriais para atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de processos produtivos, contribuindo tecnicamente para a evolução industrial da companhia.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e propor melhorias em processos produtivos internos;

  • Realizar análises de tempos, eficiência e custos industriais;
  • Apoiar validações internas de processos conforme o SGQ;
  • Atuar na análise e solução estruturada de problemas técnicos;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de melhoria contínua voltadas à produtividade e qualidade.

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em processos industriais metalmecânicos;
  • Domínio de desenho técnico e GD&T;
  • Experiência com materiais metálicos, tratamentos térmicos e superficiais;
  • Vivência com indicadores industriais;
  • Experiência com softwares CAD 3D;
  • Conhecimento prático em Lean Manufacturing.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em indústria de dispositivos médicos;
  • Conhecimento em validação de processos industriais;
  • Familiaridade com ISO 13485;
  • Experiência em ambientes produtivos de alta precisão.

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível;

title: Coordenador(a) de Banco de Dados
description:

Você será responsável por garantir a disponibilidade, segurança e performance dos nossos bancos de dados, além de liderar a equipe de DBAs, definindo padrões de arquitetura e otimizando processos de entrega (CI/CD) aplicados a dados.

+ 5 anos de experiência como coordenador(a)

Graduação completa em TI ou áreas correlatas

Sólida experiência em administração de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL ou Oracle)

Vivência com Bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra)

Experiência em Cloud: Domínio de serviços gerenciados (AWS RDS, Azure SQL, Google Cloud)

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Finance Analyst | Accounts Payable & Receivable | Campinas Region

Vinhedo / Campinas Region – São Paulo

Employment Type: CLT (Full-time)

Join a global leader in advanced materials and cutting tools

Work in an international environment supporting South American customers

Be part of a stable and growing industrial group with long-term career opportunities

About Us

GOLDEN EGRET BRASIL IMP. E EXP. DE CARBIDE LTDA (GESAC do Brasil) is the Brazilian subsidiary of Xiamen Golden Egret Special Alloy Co., Ltd. (GESAC), a globally recognized manufacturer of cemented carbide materials and cutting tools. GESAC is a state-controlled enterprise with a flawless track record—we have remained profitable every year since our founding in 1989. In 2024, we achieved a revenue of approximately €633.8 million (+10.56% YoY) and a net profit of €59.5 million. Our 2025 performance has continued this momentum, reaching a new record high.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Vinhedo (São Paulo), GESAC Brazil provides local inventory, fast delivery, and professional after-sales support to customers across South America.

GESAC is part of Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd. (XTC), a publicly listed industrial group with over 17,000 employees worldwide and €4.51 billion in revenue in 2024. The group has maintained strong and stable growth in advanced materials and precision tooling industries.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Specialist to support the financial operations of our Brazilian subsidiary.

This role will focus on accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash management, and financial coordination, ensuring accurate financial processes and supporting the company’s operational and compliance requirements.

You will work closely with management, external accounting providers, and international teams, gaining exposure to global business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage Accounts Receivable (AR) processes, including invoice tracking, payment follow-ups, and reconciliation.
  • Handle Accounts Payable (AP), expense verification, and payment scheduling.
  • Monitor cash flow and company bank accounts, ensuring accurate transaction records.
  • Perform bank reconciliations and financial data verification.
  • Maintain and organize financial documentation and accounting archives.
  • Support payroll coordination and salary-related financial processes.
  • Assist with expense management and internal financial controls.
  • Provide English–Portuguese translation support for financial communication when required.
  • Support other financial activities compatible with the position and applicable regulations.

What We’re Looking For

✔ Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or Business Administration (preferred)

✔ Experience in finance operations, accounting, AR/AP, or financial administration (preferred)

✔Portuguese: Native

✔ English: Intermediate or Advanced

✔ Solid financial and accounting knowledge

✔ Strong analytical and organizational skills

✔ Good knowledge of Excel and financial systems / ERP

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package compliant with Brazilian labor laws (CLT).

Compensation

  • base salary (BRL): Around BRL/month
  • Performance-based bonus

Benefits

  • 13th Salary (Décimo Terceiro)
  • 30 days paid vacation
  • FGTS contributions
  • Vale-Alimentação
  • Vale-Transporte
  • Private Health & Dental Plan
  • Wellness Program
  • Communication Allowance
  • Christmas Gift Card / Voucher

Location: Vinhedo – São Paulo (Campinas Metropolitan Region)

If you are looking to build your career in an international industrial company with strong global backing , we would be happy to meet you.

Apply now via LinkedIn

title: Executivo(a) Comercial | Campinas, São Paulo | Liora Energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil

Nossa Proposta de Valor:

  • Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.
  • Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.
  • Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

description:

  • Conhecimento em otimização de desempenho.
  • Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls (chamadas de sistema) para utilizar os recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V.
  • Conhecimentos e experiência com bootloaders e códigos de inicialização: UEFI, U-Boot, EDK II, Open-SBI.
  • Contribuições em projetos de código aberto.
  • Conhecimento em análise e otimização de desempenho.
  • Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls para utilização dos recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V
  • Experiência na caracterização (profiling) de desempenho de aplicações e uso de ferramentas como perf e eBPF.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to our executive team. This role is key in ensuring smooth coordination, communication, and operational efficiency across the organization.

Key responsibilities

  • Efficiently manage and prioritize executive calendars, schedules, appointments, and travel arrangements.
  • Draft, edit, and prepare professional documents including emails, memos, reports, and presentations.
  • Screen and prioritize incoming communication to ensure timely responses and proper direction.
  • Coordinate and organize meetings, conferences, and events, including all logistics and materials preparation.
  • Take clear and accurate meeting minutes, distribute them, and follow up on action items.
  • Maintain confidential files, records, and databases with high accuracy and discretion.
  • Build positive relationships with internal staff, clients, partners, and key stakeholders.
  • Act as liaison between executives and internal/external parties to ensure effective communication.
  • Support special projects, research, and analysis assigned by the executives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement efficient administrative systems.

Qualifications and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field (preferred).
  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative role.
  • Trilingual proficiency: Spanish, English, and Portuguese (required).
  • Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Strong proficiency with productivity tools (Microsoft Office / Teams / Outlook).
  • Research and project management skills.
  • High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive information.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships at all levels.
  • Proactive mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to shifting priorities and work demands.
  • Industry/sector knowledge is a plus.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sap
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ
Sobre o Grupo LPJ:
Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website
Youtube
Privacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms

Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension

Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones

Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Technical business analyst id52085
description:
Agile Engine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Business Analyst in data and digital transformation, you will play a pivotal role in connecting business goals with technical solutions, shaping how teams leverage data and integrations across the organization. You’ll influence the design of processes, pipelines, and analytics, driving efficiency and insight while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, contributing directly to measurable impact and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative culture.

- Translate business concepts into structured technical requirements, use cases, and user stories;
- Define data and integration requirements in collaboration with architects;
- Map current- and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency;

- Support efforts to standardize KPIs and enable self-service analytics using BI tools;

- Collaborate with data governance leadership to ensure quality, compliance, and consistent usage of data assets;
- Assist in the design and implementation of new data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations across cloud environments;
- Partner with architects to document data lineage, source-to-target mappings, and system dependencies;
- Analyze and communicate technical constraints, data availability, and system impacts to business sponsors;
- Coordinate with engineering teams to perform user acceptance testing and validate results.
MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Product Owner in data, IT, or digital transformation contexts;
- Strong ability to bridge business language and technical concepts;
- Knowledge of data systems , cloud services (AWS preferred) , and integration frameworks such as APIs ;
- Experience writing detailed functional specifications , user stories , process diagrams , and acceptance criteria ;
- Understanding of data modeling concepts , ETL pipelines , and BI/reporting workflows ;
- Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;
- Collaborative approach in team settings spanning technical and business disciplines;
- Upper-intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
- Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries;
- Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, and data catalog systems.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, Tech Talks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.
